text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then, today's Japanese Culture Study 
Group will be about ikebana. Let's get 
right to it~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪ I've really been looking forward 
to Japanese flower arrangement!
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text:
One day, Fine Motion mentioned she was 
going to learn about Japanese culture, so 
I decided to join in.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In ikebana, we think about bringing out 
the "life" of the flowers. Calm your mind, 
face the flowers closely, and have a 
dialogue with them~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First, let's choose the main flower. I've 
prepared a few options... Is there any 
flower that catches your eye?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Ah, maybe I'll go with that cherry 
tree in the back? It's a flower that holds 
a lot of memories for me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I was thinking about studying abroad 
in my room back home, I saw a photo of 
cherry blossoms in full bloom! I just 
thought, 'Ah, Japan is so beautiful.'

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Cherry blossoms are one of Japan's most 
iconic flowers, after all. I see, I 
see~..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Choosing flowers with personal meaning is 
a wonderful idea for ikebana. Let's go 
with that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We picked the flowers, so all that's 
left... is the conversation, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How can I bring out your true beauty? The 
contrast of the blue sky and white 
petals... It truly was love at first 
sight.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And then, when we finally met in Japan, I 
was so moved! We passed under the cherry 
blossom tunnels again and again, getting 
showered in petals...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This looks like it will turn out 
wonderfully~♪ The balance of heights is 
great, and the arrangement is simply 
impeccable.

Watching her surprisingly delicate and 
graceful movements, I continued working, 
imagining that it would surely turn out to 
be an exquisite piece...

Her finished work is finally 
complete—dignified, and unwavering—

A boulder-like power was present right 
there—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this is what's truly 
inside Fine-senpai's heart... her true 
self, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it feels like you saw right through 
me, which is a little embarrassing!

Surprised by the powerful impression the 
piece gave rather than a delicate one, I 
stepped closer to take a better look. Just 
then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Look out!
(*thump*—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: “—Are you alright? Are you hurt?”

It seems she tripped over a desk leg... 
Fine Motion caught her right before she 
hit the ground, but...

Why is it...? I can see something behind 
her... Could this be—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe that was a bit ill-mannered 
of me in the heat of the moment? But I'm 
glad you weren't hurt!

Just a moment ago, I thought she was 
delicate, but now she seems incredibly 
dependable... I see, so this is what I 
felt from that flower arrangement...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Legs stepping forward without hesitation, 
an unwavering center of gravity, supple 
extension... and follow-through.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That body movement just now was simply 
wonderful~. Fine-senpai, do you have any 
martial arts experience?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I've dabbled in fencing before. Just 
a little bit, though."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see! Your unbroken posture, your 
unwavering spirit... even throughout the 
process of arranging the flowers, it was 
truly a sight to behold.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'm honored, but you're praising me 
too much~. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? Hullo~? What's the matter?
choice_data_list: I was overwhelmed by that sheer power...

I just thought it was such an enlightening 
gathering.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Forgive me, dear, I had no idea I 
would startle you so much!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I do not believe there is any need 
to apologize. I am sure it simply stems 
from feelings of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Umm... so basically, you thought I was 
cool?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, having you think that way about 
me might not feel so bad after all!

It was an event where one could catch a 
glimpse of her charm, possessing both 
grace and strength.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: True, it was a very fruitful meeting!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you join us next time as 
well? I feel like we'd learn twice as much 
that way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what should we do next~? Since 
we're here, something multiple people can 
participate in would be nice...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You definitely should try judo!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Win without opposing"... When I first 
heard that, I was so deeply impressed! I 
really wanted to understand the heart 
behind it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer's here too, we can do sparring 
and matches! Right?! What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's true~ It feels like it might 
go beyond just a learning experience, so 
perhaps another time would be better...?

My heart skipped a beat for a second, but 
all things considered... seeing Fine 
Motion's eyes sparkle with curiosity and 
witnessing her eagerness to learn left a 
deep impression on me.
